commands.name: sheets.list
commands.description: List the sheets in the open Reckon workbook, e.g. "what sheets are in my spreadsheet".

commands.name: range.read
commands.description: Read the values and formulas in a range of the Reckon spreadsheet, e.g. "what is in A1 to C10 on Sheet1".

ref.description: Sheet name and A1 range of at most 2,000 cells, e.g. "Sheet1!A1:C10", or a reckon:// address such as "reckon://current/Sheet1/A1:C10"

commands.name: range.write
commands.description: Write values or formulas into the Reckon spreadsheet, e.g. "put 42 in B2 on Sheet1".

ref.description: Sheet name and top-left cell, e.g. "Sheet1!B2"

values.description: Rows of cells, e.g. [[1, 2], [3, "=A1+B1"]]. Text that starts with = is a formula; null clears the cell.

commands.name: formula.eval
commands.description: Work out a formula without changing the Reckon spreadsheet, e.g. "what is the sum of A1 to A9 on Sheet1".

sheet.description: The sheet its cell references read from, e.g. "Sheet1"

commands.name: recalc
commands.description: Recompute every formula in the Reckon workbook, e.g. "recalculate my spreadsheet".

commands.name: workbook.read
commands.description: Summarise the Reckon workbook for an agent: each sheet with its used range, data blocks and their header rows, frozen panes, hidden rows and columns, charts, pivot tables, conditional formatting and validation rules, notes, named ranges and the selection, e.g. "what is in my spreadsheet and where".

maxBlocks.description: Data blocks listed per sheet, 1 to 20 (default 5)

commands.name: sheet.add
commands.label: Add sheet
commands.description: Add a sheet to the Reckon workbook, e.g. "add a sheet called Summary".

name.description: Name of the new sheet, e.g. "Summary"; "SheetN" when left out

index.description: Position from 0 (first); the end when left out

commands.name: sheet.rename
commands.label: Rename sheet
commands.description: Rename a sheet in the Reckon workbook, e.g. "rename Sheet1 to Sales".

sheet.description: Current sheet name, e.g. "Sheet1"

commands.name: sheet.delete
commands.label: Delete sheet
commands.description: Delete a sheet from the Reckon workbook (undo restores it), e.g. "delete the Scratch sheet".

sheet.description: Sheet name, e.g. "Sheet1"

commands.name: sheet.duplicate
commands.label: Duplicate sheet
commands.description: Copy a sheet with its cells, formats and rules but without its charts or pivot tables, e.g. "duplicate the March sheet as April".

sheet.description: Sheet name, e.g. "Sheet1"

name.description: Name of the copy, e.g. "April"; "<name> (2)" when left out

commands.name: sheet.move
commands.label: Move sheet
commands.description: Move a sheet to another position among the tabs, e.g. "make Summary the first sheet".

sheet.description: Sheet name, e.g. "Sheet1"

commands.name: sheet.hide
commands.label: Hide sheet
commands.description: Hide a sheet tab while at least one sheet stays visible, e.g. "hide the Lookup sheet".

sheet.description: Sheet name, e.g. "Sheet1"

commands.name: sheet.unhide
commands.label: Unhide sheet
commands.description: Show a hidden sheet tab again, e.g. "unhide the Lookup sheet".

sheet.description: Sheet name, e.g. "Sheet1"

commands.name: sheet.color
commands.label: Tab colour
commands.description: Set or remove the colour of a sheet tab, e.g. "colour the Sales tab blue".

sheet.description: Sheet name, e.g. "Sheet1"

color.description: Colour as #rrggbb, e.g. "#1a5fb4"; null removes it

commands.name: rows.insert
commands.label: Insert rows
commands.description: Insert blank rows above a row, e.g. "insert 3 rows above row 5 on Sheet1".

sheet.description: Sheet name, e.g. "Sheet1"; the active sheet when left out

row.description: Row number from 1; the new rows go above it

commands.name: rows.delete
commands.label: Delete rows
commands.description: Delete rows and move the rows below up, e.g. "delete rows 4 to 6".

sheet.description: Sheet name, e.g. "Sheet1"; the active sheet when left out

row.description: First row number to delete, from 1

commands.name: rows.hide
commands.label: Hide rows
commands.description: Hide rows without deleting them, e.g. "hide rows 10 to 20".

sheet.description: Sheet name, e.g. "Sheet1"; the active sheet when left out

commands.name: rows.unhide
commands.label: Unhide rows
commands.description: Show hidden rows again, e.g. "unhide rows 10 to 20".

sheet.description: Sheet name, e.g. "Sheet1"; the active sheet when left out

commands.name: cols.insert
commands.label: Insert columns
commands.description: Insert blank columns to the left of a column, e.g. "insert a column before C".

sheet.description: Sheet name, e.g. "Sheet1"; the active sheet when left out

col.description: Column letter; the new columns go to its left, e.g. "C"

commands.name: cols.delete
commands.label: Delete columns
commands.description: Delete columns and move the columns to their right leftwards, e.g. "delete columns D and E".

sheet.description: Sheet name, e.g. "Sheet1"; the active sheet when left out

col.description: First column letter to delete, e.g. "D"

commands.name: cols.hide
commands.label: Hide columns
commands.description: Hide columns without deleting them, e.g. "hide column B".

sheet.description: Sheet name, e.g. "Sheet1"; the active sheet when left out

commands.name: cols.unhide
commands.label: Unhide columns
commands.description: Show hidden columns again, e.g. "unhide column B".

sheet.description: Sheet name, e.g. "Sheet1"; the active sheet when left out

commands.name: range.merge
commands.label: Merge cells
commands.description: Merge a range into one cell, keeping only the top-left value, e.g. "merge A1 to D1 for a title".

ref.description: Sheet name and A1 range, e.g. "Sheet1!A1:C10"; without a sheet name it means the active sheet

commands.name: range.unmerge
commands.label: Unmerge cells
commands.description: Split every merged cell that overlaps a range, e.g. "unmerge A1 to D1".

ref.description: Sheet name and A1 range, e.g. "Sheet1!A1:C10"; without a sheet name it means the active sheet

commands.name: range.clear
commands.label: Clear
commands.description: Clear the contents, the formats or both from a range, e.g. "clear B2 to D20 but keep the formatting".

ref.description: Sheet name and A1 range, e.g. "Sheet1!A1:C10"; without a sheet name it means the active sheet

what.description: contents (default) keeps formats, formats keeps values, all clears both

commands.name: format.set
commands.label: Format cells
commands.description: Format a range: number format, bold, italic, underline, strikethrough, font size and family, text and fill colour, alignment, wrap and borders, e.g. "make row 1 bold and show column C as rupees".

ref.description: Sheet name and A1 range of at most 20,000 cells, e.g. "Sheet1!A1:D1"

numberFormat.description: A format code such as "#,##0.00", "0%", "dd-mm-yyyy" or "General", or an object such as {"kind":"currency","code":"INR","decimals":2}; kinds are general, number, currency (INR, USD, EUR, GBP, JPY), percent, date, text, custom

bold.description: true sets bold, false removes it

italic.description: true sets italic, false removes it

underline.description: true sets underline, false removes it

strike.description: true sets strikethrough, false removes it

size.description: Font size in points (8, 9, 10, 11, 12, 14, 16, 18, 22, 24, 26 or 36); null resets it

color.description: Text colour slot: "0" to "9" grey (0 lightest), "a" accent blue, "r" red, "g" green, "o" amber; null resets it

fill.description: Fill colour slot: "0" to "9" grey (0 lightest) or "a" accent blue; null removes the fill

wrap.description: true wraps text in the cell, false stops wrapping

border.description: "all" (every cell edge), "outline" (around the range), "top", "bottom", "left", "right", a set of sides such as "tb", or "none"; null removes borders

commands.name: range.sort
commands.label: Sort range
commands.description: Sort the rows of a range by one or more columns, keeping a header row in place, e.g. "sort A1 to D50 by column C, largest first".

ref.description: Sheet name and A1 range of the whole table, e.g. "Sheet1!A1:D50"

keys.description: Sort keys in order, 1 to 8, e.g. [{"column":"C","order":"desc"},{"column":"A","order":"asc"}]

header.description: true keeps the first row in place; detected from the data when left out

commands.name: range.filter
commands.label: Filter
commands.description: Show only the rows whose value in one column is in a list, or clear the filter, changing only the view and not the data, e.g. "show only rows where column B is North".

sheet.description: Sheet name, e.g. "Sheet1"; the active sheet when left out

column.description: Column letter to filter by, e.g. "B"; the top row of the block of filled cells around the selection (or around the column's first value) stays as the header

keep.description: Values to show, as the cells display them, e.g. ["North", "South"]; "(blanks)" keeps empty cells

clear.description: true removes the filter and shows every row

commands.name: data.remove_duplicates
commands.label: Remove duplicates
commands.description: Remove repeated rows from a range, keeping the first of each, e.g. "remove duplicate rows from A1 to C100 by email in column B".

ref.description: Sheet name and A1 range of the table, e.g. "Sheet1!A1:C100"

columns.description: Column letters to compare, e.g. ["B"]; every column of the range when left out

header.description: true leaves the first row out of the comparison; detected when left out

commands.name: data.trim
commands.label: Trim spaces
commands.description: Remove spaces at the start and end of text cells and collapse repeated inner spaces, e.g. "trim the spaces in column A".

ref.description: Sheet name and A1 range, e.g. "Sheet1!A1:C10"; without a sheet name it means the active sheet

commands.name: data.split
commands.label: Split text to columns
commands.description: Split text in one column into several columns at a delimiter, overwriting the cells to the right, e.g. "split the names in A2 to A40 at the comma".

ref.description: Sheet name and cells in one column, e.g. "Sheet1!A2:A40"

delimiter.description: Where to split, 1 to 10 characters, e.g. "," (default), ";" or " "

commands.name: names.set
commands.label: Named ranges
commands.description: Define or change a named range, e.g. "name B2 to B20 on Sheet1 Sales".

name.description: Name, starting with a letter or underscore, e.g. "Sales"

ref.description: The range it names, e.g. "Sheet1!B2:B20", or a formula starting with =

commands.name: names.delete
commands.label: Delete name
commands.description: Delete a named range, e.g. "remove the name Sales".

commands.name: freeze.set
commands.label: Freeze panes
commands.description: Freeze rows at the top and columns at the left so they stay in view, or unfreeze with zeros, e.g. "freeze the header row".

sheet.description: Sheet name, e.g. "Sheet1"; the active sheet when left out

rows.description: Rows to freeze from the top, 0 to 1000 (default 0)

cols.description: Columns to freeze from the left, 0 to 100 (default 0)

commands.name: note.set
commands.label: Edit note
commands.description: Add or replace the note on a cell, e.g. "add a note to B4 saying check this figure".

ref.description: Sheet name and one cell, e.g. "Sheet1!B4"

text.description: The note text, up to 32,767 characters

commands.name: note.delete
commands.label: Delete note
commands.description: Delete the notes on every cell in a range, e.g. "remove the notes in column B".

ref.description: Sheet name and A1 range, e.g. "Sheet1!A1:C10"; without a sheet name it means the active sheet

commands.name: chart.add
commands.label: Insert chart
commands.description: Add a chart drawn from a range, with labels taken from a text first row or column, e.g. "chart A1 to C13 as a line chart titled Monthly sales".

ref.description: Sheet name and A1 range of the data with its labels, e.g. "Sheet1!A1:C13"

position.description: Top-left corner in pixels from the sheet corner, e.g. {"x": 400, "y": 40}

options.description: Chart detail, every key optional: {"xTitle":"Month","yTitle":"Sales","y2Title":"Margin %","legend":"auto|top|bottom|left|right|none","dataLabels":"none|value|percent","stack":"none|stacked|percent","yMin":0,"yMax":100,"yStep":10,"yFormat":"#,##0","gridlines":true}; on chart.update a key set to null goes back to its default

series.description: Per-series settings in data order, e.g. [{"kind":"column"},{"kind":"line","axis":"secondary","trendline":{"type":"linear","showEquation":true,"showR2":true}}]; kind is column, line or area; trendline type is linear, exp or movingAvg (with "period": 2 to 100)

commands.name: chart.update
commands.label: Chart settings
commands.description: Change the type, title, data range, orientation, label rows, position, size, axis titles, legend, data labels, stacking, axis bounds, secondary axis or trendlines of a chart, e.g. "make chart ch1 a stacked bar chart with the legend on the right".

id.description: Chart id from workbook.read or chart.add

sheet.description: Sheet the chart is on; searched when left out

dataRange.description: A1 range on the sheet of the chart, e.g. "A1:C13"

orientation.description: Series in columns or in rows

headerRow.description: true when the first row holds series names

headerCol.description: true when the first column holds category labels

options.description: Chart detail, every key optional: {"xTitle":"Month","yTitle":"Sales","y2Title":"Margin %","legend":"auto|top|bottom|left|right|none","dataLabels":"none|value|percent","stack":"none|stacked|percent","yMin":0,"yMax":100,"yStep":10,"yFormat":"#,##0","gridlines":true}; on chart.update a key set to null goes back to its default

series.description: Per-series settings in data order, e.g. [{"kind":"column"},{"kind":"line","axis":"secondary","trendline":{"type":"linear","showEquation":true,"showR2":true}}]; kind is column, line or area; trendline type is linear, exp or movingAvg (with "period": 2 to 100)

commands.name: chart.delete
commands.label: Delete chart
commands.description: Delete a chart, e.g. "remove chart ch1".

id.description: Chart id from workbook.read or chart.add

sheet.description: Sheet the chart is on; searched when left out

commands.name: cf.set
commands.label: Conditional formatting
commands.description: Set the conditional formatting rules for a range, replacing the rules already on exactly that range, e.g. "highlight values over 100 in B2 to B50 in red".

ref.description: Sheet name and A1 range the rules apply to, e.g. "Sheet1!B2:B50"

rules.description: Rules in priority order; [] removes the rules on this range. Shapes: {"type":"cellValue","op":"gt","v1":100,"format":{"bg":"#f8d7da","fg":"#842029","bold":true}} (ops gt, lt, ge, le, eq, ne, between, notBetween with v2, contains, notContains, beginsWith, endsWith, duplicate, unique, top, bottom (v1 = how many), topPct, bottomPct (v1 = percent), aboveAvg, belowAvg, aboveStd, belowStd (v1 = standard deviations, 1 to 3), blank, notBlank, error, noError, dateIs (v1 one of yesterday, today, tomorrow, last7, lastWeek, thisWeek, nextWeek, lastMonth, thisMonth, nextMonth)); {"type":"formula","formula":"=$C2>$B2","format":{...}}; {"type":"colorScale","scale":{"min":"#ffffff","max":"#8fb4dd"}}; {"type":"dataBar","bar":{"color":"#1a5fb4"}}; {"type":"iconSet","icons":{"set":"traffic3","thresholds":[{"kind":"percent","value":33},{"kind":"percent","value":67}],"reverse":false,"iconOnly":false}} (sets arrows3, traffic3, flags3, ratings4, quarters5; one threshold fewer than icons, each the lower bound of the next band, kind percent, number or percentile; leave thresholds out for equal percent bands)

commands.name: dv.set
commands.label: Data validation
commands.description: Set or remove the data validation rule for a range, e.g. "only allow Yes or No in C2 to C100".

ref.description: Sheet name and A1 range the rule checks, e.g. "Sheet1!C2:C100"

rule.description: null removes the rule on this range. Shapes: {"type":"list","values":["Yes","No"]}; {"type":"list","source":"range","ref":"E2:E10"}; {"type":"number","op":"between","v1":0,"v2":100} (also date and textLength; ops between, notBetween, gt, lt, ge, le, eq, ne); {"type":"custom","formula":"=ISNUMBER(C2)"}; add "onInvalid":"warn" to flag instead of reject (default reject) and "help" for the message

commands.name: pivot.set
commands.label: Pivot table
commands.description: Add or replace a pivot table that summarises a table on the same sheet, with calculated fields, date and number grouping, row sorting and values shown as percents or running totals, e.g. "pivot A1 to D200 to total Sales by Region, largest first".

source.description: Sheet name and A1 range of the table with its header row, e.g. "Sheet1!A1:D200"

rows.description: Header names to group rows by, e.g. ["Region"]

cols.description: Header names to spread across columns, e.g. ["Year"]

values.description: What to total, e.g. [{"field":"Sales","agg":"sum"}]; agg is sum, count, countUnique, average, min or max; add "showAs": "pctGrand", "pctRow", "pctCol" or "runningTotal" to show a value as a percent of a total or as a running total; a calculated field from options.calcFields is named like any field

filters.description: Values to keep per header, e.g. [{"field":"Year","values":[2025]}]

position.description: Top-left cell of the pivot on the same sheet, e.g. "H1"; two columns right of the source when left out

id.description: Id of an existing pivot to replace; a new pivot when left out

options.description: Pivot detail, every key optional: {"calcFields":[{"name":"Margin","formula":"=Revenue-Cost"}],"groups":{"Date":{"by":"month"},"Price":{"by":"bins","size":100}},"sort":{"by":"value","dir":"desc","value":0}}; group by is year, quarter, month, day or bins; sort by is label or value

commands.name: pivot.delete
commands.label: Delete pivot table
commands.description: Delete a pivot table, e.g. "remove pivot pv1".

id.description: Pivot id from workbook.read or pivot.set

sheet.description: Sheet the pivot is on; searched when left out

commands.name: workbook.export
commands.label: Export
commands.description: Export the Reckon workbook as csv (one sheet), xlsx, ods or the reckon json file and return the file in the result, with a list of anything the format could not hold, e.g. "give me Sheet1 as a csv file".

kind.description: File type (default json); xlsx and ods come back base64-encoded

sheet.description: Sheet to export as csv; the active sheet when left out

keepFormatting.description: For xlsx: write fonts, fills, borders, alignment, conditional formatting and data validation (default: the Keep formatting setting, on unless turned off)

commands.name: view.select
commands.description: Show a sheet and select a range on it, changing only the view, e.g. "go to Sales and select B2".

ref.description: Sheet name and A1 cell or range, e.g. "Sales!B2:D10"

commands.name: script.run
commands.label: Run script
commands.description: Run a list of Reckon commands as one change with one undo step, where a later step can use the results of earlier steps and a failing step leaves the workbook unchanged, e.g. "add a Summary sheet, write a table on it and make the header bold".

steps.description: Steps in order, 1 to 200, each {"command": name, "input": {...}}; a string "$N.key" in an input stands for that key of the result of step N (from 1), e.g. "$1.id"; read steps see the workbook as it was before the script; view steps run after the change applies; workbook.export and script.run cannot be steps; a step that deletes (sheet.delete, rows.delete, range.clear and the other destructive commands) is refused here, so use script.run_destructive for it

label.description: A short name for the change, e.g. "Build summary"

commands.name: script.run_destructive
commands.description: Run a list of Reckon commands as one change with one undo step, including steps that delete or replace work, which the person reviews every time, e.g. "delete the old Draft sheet and rename Final to Summary".

steps.description: Steps in order, 1 to 200, each {"command": name, "input": {...}}, with the same rules as script.run; destructive steps such as sheet.delete and rows.delete are allowed here

label.description: A short name for the change, e.g. "Build summary"

commands.label: Run script that deletes

commands.name: style.apply
commands.label: Apply cell style
commands.description: Apply a named cell style to a range (the built-in Normal, Title, Heading 1, Heading 2, Total, Good, Bad, Neutral, Input, Output, Calculation, Note, Currency and Percent, or a style saved in the workbook), e.g. "make A1 a Heading 1".

ref.description: Sheet name and A1 range, e.g. "Sheet1!A1:D1"

commands.name: style.save
commands.label: Save cell style
commands.description: Save one cell's format as a named style kept in the workbook, or remove a saved style, e.g. "save the look of B2 as Highlight".

name.description: Style name, 1 to 64 characters, not a built-in style name

ref.description: Sheet name and the one cell whose format becomes the style, e.g. "Sheet1!B2"; not needed with remove

remove.description: true removes the saved style with this name

commands.name: link.set
commands.label: Insert link
commands.description: Put an http, https or mailto link in a cell as a HYPERLINK formula, or remove the link and keep the text it shows, e.g. "link A2 to our website as Website".

ref.description: Sheet name and one cell, e.g. "Sheet1!A2"

url.description: Web or email address ("example.com" gets https://, "a@b.org" gets mailto:); null removes the link

label.description: Text or number the cell shows; the URL shows when left out

commands.name: checkbox.insert
commands.label: Insert checkboxes
commands.description: Turn cells into checkboxes that show TRUE or FALSE as a tick box (blank cells become FALSE), or remove the checkbox look, e.g. "add checkboxes to D2 to D20".

ref.description: Sheet name and A1 range, e.g. "Sheet1!D2:D20"

remove.description: true removes the checkbox look and keeps the values

commands.name: protect.set
commands.label: Protect sheet
commands.description: Protect a sheet from accidental edits (there is no password, so it guards against accidents, not people) or lift the protection, with optional ranges that stay editable, e.g. "protect Sheet1 except B2 to B20".

sheet.description: Sheet name; the active sheet when left out

protected.description: true protects the sheet, false lifts the protection

allowedRanges.description: A1 ranges that stay editable while protected, e.g. ["B2:B20"]; replaces the current list

commands.name: fill.from_examples
commands.label: Fill from examples
commands.description: Fill a column from 1 to 3 examples typed at its top, using the columns beside it, as a formula where one fits and as values otherwise, e.g. "fill column C with the first names from column A like the examples".

ref.description: Sheet name and one-column A1 range holding the examples and the blank cells to fill, e.g. "Sheet1!C2:C50"; a first row that does not fit the pattern is treated as a header

sources.description: Column letters to take the examples from, e.g. ["A", "B"]; when left out, the filled cells next to the first example

commands.name: sheet.explain
commands.label: Explain sheet
commands.description: Describe the structure of the workbook or one sheet without a model: used ranges, header rows, formula patterns grouped by shape, links between sheets, named ranges, charts, pivot tables and a small sample, e.g. "what does this spreadsheet do".

sheet.description: Sheet name; every sheet when left out

commands.name: table.create
commands.label: Format as table
commands.description: Turn a range whose first row holds the headers into a named table with banded rows, filter buttons and an optional total row, e.g. "make A1 to D20 on Sales a table called Orders".

ref.description: Sheet name and A1 range, header row first, e.g. "Sales!A1:D20"

name.description: Table name such as "Orders" (letters, digits, _ and .); Table1, Table2 and so on when left out

totals.description: Add a total row below the data with a label and a sum of the last column (default false)

commands.name: table.update
commands.label: Table settings
commands.description: Change a table's name, style, total row, banding, filter buttons, column names or total-row aggregates, e.g. "show the average of Price in the total row of Orders".

name.description: New table name; formulas that use the old name follow

totals.description: Show or remove the total row

filter.description: Show filter buttons in the header row

columns.description: Column changes, each {"column": current name, "name": new name, "total": one of sum, average, count, countNums, min, max, or null for none}

commands.name: table.delete
commands.label: Convert table to range
commands.description: Turn a table back into a plain range, keeping its cells and rewriting formulas that use its name to cell ranges, e.g. "convert the Orders table to a normal range".

commands.name: table.read
commands.label: List tables
commands.description: List the tables in the workbook with their sheets, ranges, columns, calculated-column formulas and total-row settings, e.g. "what tables does this workbook have".

table.description: One table name; every table when left out

commands.name: sparkline.set
commands.label: Sparklines
commands.description: Draw small line, column or win-loss charts inside cells from a range of numbers, one per row or column, e.g. "add sparklines in F2 to F10 for B2 to E10".

ref.description: Sheet name and the cells that draw: one cell, a column (one cell per source row) or a row (one cell per source column), e.g. "Sheet1!F2:F10"

source.description: A1 range of the numbers on the same sheet, e.g. "B2:E10"

negColor.description: Colour of negative bars and low points as #rrggbb

id.description: Id of a sparkline group to replace; a new group when left out

commands.name: sparkline.delete
commands.label: Delete sparklines
commands.description: Remove sparklines by id, or every sparkline group drawn in a range, e.g. "remove the sparklines in column F".

ref.description: Sheet name and A1 range; groups that draw in it are removed, e.g. "Sheet1!F2:F10"

sheet.description: Sheet to search for the id; all sheets when left out

commands.name: sql.run
commands.label: SQL query
commands.description: Run a read-only SQL query (DuckDB) over ranges registered as tables, first row as column names, and return up to 2,000 rows; optionally write the whole result to a new sheet or from a target cell as one change, e.g. "join Orders and Customers and total sales by city".

sql.description: One read-only statement, e.g. "SELECT Region, SUM(Sales) AS total FROM sales GROUP BY Region ORDER BY total DESC"

tables.description: Tables to register, e.g. [{"name":"sales","ref":"Sheet1!A1:D200"}]; the first row names the columns

limit.description: Rows to return (default 200); a write takes every row

write.description: Where to write the result: {"sheet":"Summary"} for a new sheet, or {"ref":"Sheet1!H1"} from a cell; add "header": false to leave out the column names; left out, nothing is written

commands.name: goal.seek
commands.label: Goal seek
commands.description: Find the value of one input cell that makes a formula cell reach a target, searching on a private copy of the workbook, then write that value as one change, e.g. "what price in B2 makes the profit in B9 equal 1000".

setCell.description: Sheet name and the formula cell to reach the target, e.g. "Sheet1!B9"

changingCell.description: The value cell to change, on the same sheet, e.g. "Sheet1!B2"

apply.description: false only reports the value without writing it (default true)

commands.name: outline.group
commands.label: Group rows or columns
commands.description: Group rows or columns into a collapsible outline, one level deeper (at most 7), e.g. "group rows 5 to 9".

sheet.description: Sheet name, e.g. "Sheet1"; the active sheet when left out

row.description: First row number, from 1; give row or col

col.description: First column letter, e.g. "C"; give row or col

count.description: How many rows or columns from row or col (default 1)

commands.name: outline.ungroup
commands.label: Ungroup rows or columns
commands.description: Take rows or columns one outline level out of their group, e.g. "ungroup rows 5 to 9".

sheet.description: Sheet name, e.g. "Sheet1"; the active sheet when left out

row.description: First row number, from 1; give row or col

col.description: First column letter, e.g. "C"; give row or col

count.description: How many rows or columns from row or col (default 1)

commands.name: outline.collapse
commands.label: Collapse group
commands.description: Collapse (hide) the outline group around a row or column, or show only the outline levels below a number, e.g. "collapse the group around row 6" or "show outline level 1".

sheet.description: Sheet name, e.g. "Sheet1"; the active sheet when left out

row.description: A row inside the group, from 1

col.description: A column inside the group, e.g. "C"

axis.description: rows or cols (default rows), when neither row nor col is given

level.description: With row or col: which enclosing group, by outline level (default the innermost). Without them: show only what is grouped less deeply than this level (1 shows only ungrouped rows), like the level buttons

commands.name: outline.expand
commands.label: Expand group
commands.description: Expand (show) the outline group around a row or column, or every group, e.g. "expand all groups".

sheet.description: Sheet name, e.g. "Sheet1"; the active sheet when left out

row.description: A row inside the group, from 1

col.description: A column inside the group, e.g. "C"

axis.description: rows or cols (default rows), when neither row nor col is given

level.description: With row or col: which enclosing group, by outline level (default the innermost)

all.description: Without row or col: true expands every group on the axis

commands.name: view.zoom
commands.label: Zoom
commands.description: Zoom the grid of a sheet from 50% to 200%, changing only the view, e.g. "zoom to 150%".

percent.description: Zoom percentage, 50 to 200 (100 is normal size)

sheet.description: Sheet name, e.g. "Sheet1"; the active sheet when left out

commands.name: version.list
commands.label: Version history
commands.description: List the saved versions of the workbook (newest first) with their names, times and sizes, e.g. "what versions of this workbook are saved".

commands.name: version.save
commands.label: Save version
commands.description: Save a named version of the whole workbook that you can restore later, e.g. "save a version called Before cleanup".

commands.name: version.restore
commands.label: Restore version
commands.description: Restore the workbook to a saved version as one change you can undo, e.g. "go back to the version called Before cleanup".

commands.name: version.delete
commands.label: Delete version
commands.description: Delete a saved version after the person confirms it in Reckon, e.g. "delete the version called Draft".

commands.name: range.subscribe
commands.description: Watch a range of the Reckon spreadsheet as a live source, so Reckon posts its new values on the reckon channel whenever a cell in it changes, e.g. "keep me updated on A1 to C10 on Sheet1".

ref.description: Sheet name and A1 range of at most 10,000 cells, e.g. "Sheet1!A1:C10", or a reckon:// address

commands.name: range.unsubscribe
commands.description: Stop watching a live range you started watching, e.g. "stop updating me on that range".

id.description: Subscription id that the watch returned, e.g. "live1"

commands.name: review.status
commands.description: Tell whether a change Reckon staged for the person's review is still pending, was committed or discarded, or was dropped because the sheet changed, e.g. "did the person accept my change".

proposal_id.description: The proposal_id a staged write returned, e.g. "prop_123"
